Type: small open bookshelf
Use: storing books and decor, side table use; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: farmhouse, rustic, industrial
Materials: engineered wood in a walnut finish
Colors: dark warm walnut brown
Shape: compact square frame with three open tiers, X-shaped cross braces on the sides, sturdy corner posts, low and squat, open

Type: narrow bookcase with drawers

Type: metal picture ledge shelf

Materials: powder-coated steel
Colors: matte black
Shape: long narrow L-shaped ledge with a raised front lip, visible screw holes, slim and very light, wall-mounted
Feel: clean, graphic, understated
Goes with: white or grey walls, black frames, light wood; minimalist, Scandinavian or modern rooms
